portalPage.title: The digital platform for employment and vocational-training data collection.
portalPage.lede: CAM-LEAP is the ongoing modernisation project through which ONEFOP is equipping Cameroon with a digital platform for the collection, analysis, and dissemination of employment and vocational-training data — replacing paper questionnaires with authenticated online declaration, within a secure framework.
portalPage.heroRequirement: Registration and sign-in are required before submitting a declaration.
portalPage.phaseStatus: Phase 1 in service: digital collection is open to employers & CFP centres
portalPage.doorsIntro: Register an establishment and sign in before declaring. Your registered profile determines the applicable questionnaire.
portalPage.door1Desc: Statutory declaration of headcounts, occupations, wage brackets, and unfilled vacancies.
portalPage.door2Desc: National census of accredited programmes, enrolled learners, graduates, equipment, and placement rates.
portalPage.authorityBody: only declarations transmitted through CAMLEAP are recorded by ONEFOP. No document is required outside the platform and no payment is ever requested.
portalPage.receiptBody: every validated declaration produces an official PDF receipt carrying a unique ONEFOP tracking number.
portalPage.roadmapIntro: A staged transition from authenticated collection to future validated analysis and appropriate dissemination.
portalPage.phase1Desc: Registration, authentication, bilingual declarations, drafts, validation, submission confirmation, and authenticated history.
portalPage.phase2Desc: Validated indicators, dashboards, and appropriate public dissemination are in development.
portalPage.phase3Title: Phase 3 — Enterprise space and peer benchmarking
portalPage.phase3Desc: Sector peer intelligence and salary benchmarking are not currently available.
portalPage.phase4Title: Phase 4 — Multi-agency interoperability and web-based signals
portalPage.phase4Desc: Potential future coordination with other data sources; external integrations are not currently implemented.
portalPage.helpHeading: Here when you need a hand.
portalPage.helpBody: Get help with registration, sign-in, two-factor verification, NIU or accreditation references, questionnaires, drafts, and submissions.
portalPage.footerMinistry: Ministry of Employment and Vocational Training (MINEFOP) · Republic of Cameroon
portalPage.story1Desc: Complex printed forms, manual handling, and long delays before any data exploitation.
portalPage.story2Desc: Online entry, NIU validation, automatic draft saving, and official PDF filing receipt.
portalPage.story3Desc: National dashboards and peer comparisons by sector in phases 2 and 3.
portalPage.transformHeading: From paper to an informed decision
portalPage.transformIntro: How Cameroon is methodically modernising its labour market information system across four phases.
portalPage.transform1Desc: Retire paper bundles. Deploy direct online filing for formal employers and CFP centres.
portalPage.transform2Desc: Automated consistency checks on headcounts and payroll to eliminate input errors.
portalPage.transform3Desc: Build national observatory dashboards and anonymised sector wage benchmarking.
portalPage.transform4Desc: CNPS / FNE / INS gateways and automated harvesting of job offers across the Cameroonian web.
portalPage.benchmarkBody: Sector benchmarking and salary brackets will be delivered in Phase 3. Filing in Phase 1 helps prioritize your organization for early access — but no commercial promises are made until the analytical layer is operational.
portalPage.progressHeading: What is done and what is coming
portalPage.progressIntro: The work completed in Phase 1 lays the lasting foundation for the National Employment Observatory in Cameroon.
portalPage.achieved1Body: online data entry replaces bulky paper survey booklets for employers and CFP centres.
portalPage.achieved2Body: issued immediately upon submission as a PDF with a unique tracking number.
portalPage.achieved3Body: transformation from a retrospective observatory into a dynamic information system.
portalPage.availableBody: Employers and CFP centres can submit their statutory declarations online today.
portalPage.buildingBody: Public dashboards (Phase 2) are actively being engineered. Peer benchmarking (Phase 3) is planned.
portalPage.roadmapCurrentBody: Paper questionnaires are replaced by web teledeclarations. Employers and CFP centres file online.
portalPage.roadmapOversightBody: ONEFOP (National Observatory of Employment and Vocational Training) under MINEFOP oversight.

portalPage.aboutTitle: From paper to a digital observatory.
portalPage.aboutBody: CAM-LEAP—the Cameroon Labour Market and Employment Analytical Platform—is conceived to modernise and restructure ONEFOP, Cameroon’s National Employment and Vocational Observatory, under MINEFOP oversight. It moves paper questionnaires toward a sovereign digital Labour Market Information System and observatory infrastructure, beginning with authenticated registration and teledeclaration.
portalPage.aboutPanelTitle: A sovereign foundation for labour-market intelligence
portalPage.aboutPanelBody: Structured, authenticated collection comes first. Validated analysis and responsible dissemination follow in later phases.

site.faqRegisterQuestion: Who can register for the CAMLEAP survey?
site.faqRegisterAnswer: Employers (enterprises, public bodies, cooperatives and other eligible organisations) and eligible public and private vocational training institutions located in the pilot regions of Littoral and Centre.
site.faqDurationQuestion: How long does the survey take?
site.faqDurationAnswer: Most organisations complete the online survey in a single session. You can save your progress and return before final submission.
site.faqDataQuestion: How is my organisation’s data used?
site.faqDataAnswer: Responses are used for statistical purposes only and treated as confidential under the applicable legal framework. Results are published as aggregated indicators, never as individual organisation data.
site.homeLede: CAMLEAP collects and analyses labour market data nationwide. Organisations in the pilot regions can register and complete the ONEFOP survey online.
site.homePilotNote: Pilot phase — registration is open in Littoral and Centre.
site.journeyLabel: Six-step animation: an ONEFOP questionnaire filled in on paper; the same questionnaire completed online; responses received and validated; a labour market dashboard; a bulletin shared with employers, government and jobseekers; the programme's phases, with digital collection as the current pilot.
site.journeyCap1Body: The ONEFOP questionnaire, printed and filled in by hand.
site.journeyCap2Body: Organisations register and complete the survey online.
site.journeyCap3Body: Validated, curated data ready for analysis.
site.journeyCap4Body: ONEFOP turns the data into labour market indicators.
site.journeyCap5Body: Results are shared with employers, government and jobseekers.
site.journeyCap6Body: Digital collection is the current pilot; the observatories come next.
site.homePhase1Body: Registered organisations complete the ONEFOP survey online. Data is validated and prepared for statistical use.
site.homePhase2Body: Participating employers receive analytics and benchmarking insights to support their own recruitment and workforce decisions.
site.homePhase3Body: Indicators and analysis published for public use, giving institutions and jobseekers a shared view of the labour market.
site.homePhase4Body: Additional data sources integrated to deepen labour market intelligence across sectors and regions.
site.homeWhoTitle: Two groups make the survey work
site.homeWhoEmployersBody: Enterprises, public bodies, cooperatives and other eligible organisations.
site.homeWhoCentresBody: Eligible public and private vocational training institutions.
site.homeDataLead: Survey responses are used for statistical purposes only and treated as confidential under the applicable legal framework.
site.homeDataBody: Survey responses are used for statistical purposes only and treated as confidential under the applicable legal framework. Individual organisation data is never published.
site.homeCtaBody: Register on CAMLEAP and complete the ONEFOP survey online.
site.progLede: An ONEFOP programme, under MINEFOP, to give Cameroon reliable, up-to-date information on employment and vocational training.
site.progWhyLede: Today, Cameroon still lacks a complete, up-to-date picture of jobs and skills.
site.progWhyBody1: The information exists, but it is collected on paper, arrives late and is hard to use. Employers struggle to find the right profiles, vocational training centres lack signals on demand, and public policy relies on partial data.
site.progWhyBody2: CAMLEAP modernises this chain end to end: collect data online, process and store it in one system, then turn it into useful, public information.
site.progPillar1Body: The pipeline that collects, processes and stores data from every source. The ONEFOP survey of employers and vocational training centres is its first source.
site.progPillar2Body: The public layer that reads, analyses, publishes and visualises that same data, turning it into useful intelligence for each group of stakeholders.
site.progPhasesIntro: CAMLEAP rolls out in stages. Each phase builds on the previous one: data collected today feeds tomorrow's analysis.
site.progPhase1Title: Digital collection of the ONEFOP survey
site.progPhase1Body: The collection system is built and deployed as a pilot. The first organisations register and complete the survey online; their feedback improves it before the national rollout.
site.progPhase1Item1: Online registration of organisations, validated by ONEFOP
site.progPhase1Item2: Two questionnaires: workforce situation (employers) and vocational training (vocational training centres)
site.progPhase1Item3: One questionnaire per establishment; public administration at central level
site.progPhase1Item4: Online registration, or assisted registration for organisations that need it (details to come)
site.progPhase1Item5: Consistency checks during entry and an official receipt
site.progPhase1Item6: After the pilot: gradual opening to all organisations concerned
site.progPhase2Body: Participating employers and training institutions receive sectoral benchmarks and insights to support their recruitment and workforce planning.
site.progPhase2Item1: Sectoral benchmarks and analytics for participating organisations
site.progPhase2Item2: Visibility on emerging skills needs and training capacity
site.progPhase2Item3: Decision support for hiring, talent planning and curriculum alignment
site.progPhase2Item4: Secure reporting strictly adhering to statistical confidentiality
site.progPhase3Body: Indicators and analysis published for public use, giving institutions, policymakers and jobseekers a shared view of the labour market.
site.progPhase3Item1: Aggregated indicators and visualizations on employment and vocational training
site.progPhase3Item2: Open dashboards for public authorities, researchers and development partners
site.progPhase3Item3: Insights on in-demand professions and skills for jobseekers
site.progPhase3Item4: Aggregated results only, ensuring no individual organisation is ever identified
site.progPhase4Body: The information system progressively integrates complementary administrative and statistical data sources on the labour market.
site.progPhase4Item1: Institutional agreements with partner data producers
site.progPhase4Item2: One unified pipeline to collect, process and store every source
site.progPhase4Item3: An enriched Observatory drawing from these new complementary sources
site.progForGovBody: Employment and vocational training policy grounded in reliable data.
site.progForEmployersBody: A simpler online survey today; trends for their sector tomorrow.
site.progForCentresBody: A visible offer, and signals on the trades actually in demand.
site.progForPublicBody: Public information on jobs and skills in Cameroon.
site.progCtaBody: Every questionnaire completed today feeds tomorrow's Observatory.
site.helpLede: Everything you need to register and complete the ONEFOP survey.
site.helpEmployersBody: Any organisation that employs staff, regardless of legal form or size. Questionnaire: workforce situation.
site.helpCentresBody: Public and private vocational training institutions under MINEFOP. Questionnaire: vocational training.
site.helpEmployersPrepare: Taxpayer identification number (NIU) issued by the DGI. The CNPS number is required whenever the form asks for it.
site.helpEmployersCovers: Staff by occupational category, salaries, recruitment, departures and unfilled posts.
site.helpCentresPrepare: Reference of the accreditation or creation order issued by MINEFOP.
site.helpCentresCovers: Approved programmes, trainees, graduates, workshop equipment and job placement.
site.helpRuleSitesBody: An organisation with several sites completes one questionnaire for each.
site.helpRuleAdminBody: Collection takes place at central level only.
site.helpStep1Body: Create your organisation's account online. The registration assistant guides you through six steps:
site.helpStep1Sub1: Type of organisation: employer or vocational training centre
site.helpStep1Sub2: Person in charge: name, position, email, phone
site.helpStep1Sub3: Legal details: company name, NIU or accreditation, sector
site.helpStep2Body: ONEFOP checks your NIU or accreditation before opening access to the questionnaire. Your account stays "pending validation" until then; you are notified by email once it is active.
site.helpStep3Body: Complete the questionnaire online. Inconsistencies are flagged as you go.
site.helpStep4Body: Submit your questionnaire and immediately download your official PDF receipt, carrying a unique ONEFOP tracking number.
site.helpAssistedBody: Organisations that cannot register online on their own will be able to get support from MINEFOP and ONEFOP. Details of this assisted registration will be announced soon. Meanwhile, contact us and we will guide you.
site.faq1Answer: No. Only aggregated results that identify no organisation will be released.
site.faq2Question: Do I have to pay, or send documents outside the platform?
site.faq2Answer: No. Only answers transmitted through CAMLEAP are recorded by ONEFOP. No document is required outside the platform and no payment is ever requested.
site.faq3Question: My organisation has several sites. What do I do?
site.faq3Answer: Complete one questionnaire per establishment. Public administration is the exception: central-level collection.
site.faq4Answer: ONEFOP checks your NIU or accreditation before opening access to the questionnaire. You receive an email once it is active.
site.faq5Question: I can't register online on my own. What can I do?
site.faq5Answer: Assisted registration is planned for organisations that need it; details will be announced soon. Meanwhile, message us on WhatsApp or by email.
site.faq6Answer: The system is live and your answers are recorded. Your feedback helps us improve it before the national rollout.
site.helpContactIntro: A question about your registration or the survey? The CAMLEAP team will answer.
site.helpCtaBody: It all starts with registering your organisation.
